title: Injective surges 13%, hits a 3-month as staked INJ records new ATH: What’s next?
summary: Injective soared 13%, flipped $6 resistance, and climbed to a three-month high of $6.7.
content: Injective experienced a notable surge of 13 percent, successfully breaking past the six-dollar resistance level. The cryptocurrency climbed to reach a three-month high of six dollars and seventy cents. This upward momentum coincided with staked INJ recording a new all-time high, prompting market participants to question what might happen next for the asset.

title: Guidewire on Putting AI Agents Inside Core Insurance Workflows
summary:
Guidewire’s Diego Devalle on why claims and underwriting are ready for AI agents, and why accountability can never sit with the agent itself.
The post Guidewire on Putting AI Agents Inside Core Insurance Workflows appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Guidewire executive Diego Devalle recently discussed the integration of artificial intelligence agents into core insurance workflows, highlighting claims and underwriting as prime areas for automation. While these AI agents can significantly streamline processes, Devalle emphasized that ultimate accountability must always remain with human operators rather than the automated systems themselves.

title: Strive Buys $109 Million in Bitcoin, Pushes Preferred Stock Toward $1 Billion
summary: The Vivek Ramaswamy-founded asset manager added 1,375 BTC last week, its third straight week of 5%-plus growth.
content: Strive, the asset manager founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, has purchased $109 million in Bitcoin. The firm added 1,375 BTC last week, marking its third consecutive week of growth exceeding five percent. This aggressive accumulation strategy is part of a broader push to drive its preferred stock value toward the $1 billion milestone, highlighting growing corporate interest in cryptocurrency holdings.
